question: The ________ Polo Club is the home of the Ezra Cup event, the world's oldest polo tournament, started in 1880.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Calcutta**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Ezra Cup is recognized as the **world's oldest polo tournament**, initiated in 1880.
 
• The tournament is hosted by the **Calcutta Polo Club**, which is also the oldest polo club globally, established in 1862.
 
• The Calcutta Polo Club played a crucial role in popularizing polo internationally and preserving its legacy.
 
• Ezra Cup is named after **David Elias Ezra**, a Jewish businessperson and patron of polo in Kolkata.
 
• This prestigious tournament continues to attract players and enthusiasts from around the world, celebrating the sport's rich heritage in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Polo Origins:**

 
 
• Polo originated in ancient Persia around 2,500 years ago and was initially a training game for cavalry units.
 
• The modern version of polo was formalized by British tea planters in India during the 19th century.
 
• The game involves teams competing to score by driving a ball into the opposing team's goal using mallets.
 
 
 
• **Calcutta Polo Club:**
 
 
• Founded in 1862, the Calcutta Polo Club is considered the oldest in existence worldwide.
 
• It has significantly contributed to promoting polo and nurturing talent in India and beyond.
 
• The club is located in Kolkata, West Bengal, India.
 
 
 
• **David Elias Ezra:**
 
 
• A prominent Jewish businessman who contributed to Kolkata's development in various domains.
 
• He was a key patron of the Calcutta Polo Club and played a vital role in establishing the Ezra Cup.
 
 
 
• **Polo in India:**
 
 
• India has a rich legacy in polo, with the sport flourishing during the British colonial era.
 
• The Indian Army remains one of the major contributors to polo's development and popularity in the country.
 
• India hosts several significant polo tournaments annually, including the Ezra Cup.
